components.role: analysis, provenance, certification, and adjudication engines

components.notes: The app is a local process boundary and has no independent verification implementation.
Records are limited to regular UTF-8 files and metadata; raw text is not persisted or delivered.

components.role: typed external-ontology configuration and mapping boundary
components.reason: No authorized credentials, endpoint, ontology identifiers, live transport, or delivery observation was supplied.

components.role: proposer layer: Apple on-device, OpenAI, Anthropic
components.authority: proposes spans only; cannot express a verdict — ProposedClaim has no status field
boundaries: credential and network authorization are separate switches, both default-denied
no credential can be compiled in: ProviderCredentialStore has no concrete default
hosted output passes the same GroundingFilter as on-device output
closed kind enum; an unrecognised provider string decodes to undetermined
components.evidence: 12 tests, none touching the network; Apple on-device availability observed `available` on the build machine

components.role: read-only catalog of every vault module
components.authority: reader only; exposes no way to invoke a module
boundaries: reads Chiron/manifest.json rather than introspecting at runtime
arbitrary module dispatch intentionally absent — replaces a deleted view that had it
components.evidence: summary counts asserted equal to the detail they describe; a test asserts no execution member exists
`ci/sbom.py --check` is a gate in the battery; offline, no network lookup

shared_interfaces.name: Primus HTTP
shared_interfaces.notes: The strict v1 surface exposes capabilities, collapse, and certify only. It is not a public deployment.

shared_interfaces.name: Chiron CLI
shared_interfaces.dispatch: routes through Chiron/mcp_server.py:_IMPL — the same dict MCP clients use
shared_interfaces.note: `verify` remains a thin adapter over `primus certify` and does not go through _IMPL

provenance_and_safety.invariant: Zero false verifications; refusal is a result.
provenance_and_safety.file_policy: The macOS app shows its bounded-file and truncation state.
provenance_and_safety.network_policy: The deterministic core is local; no public HTTP or MCP exposure is enabled by default.

external_blockers: No public endpoint, authentication service, or deployment evidence is recorded.
Mac distribution requires account-owned signing, notarization, entitlements, privacy review, and release decisions.
A real Foundry/AIP delivery requires authorized credentials, ontology identifiers, transport configuration, and a delivery-observation gate.
Codex is not installed on this machine; its MCP configuration is written but unverified.
No OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY exists in the environment, so the hosted adapters are exercised only against an injected transport.
migration_notes: Do not hand-edit Chiron Monolith; rebuild it from Chiron sources.
Historical certificate artifacts may retain historical license text; do not alter hash-pinned evidence without its migration record.

environment_facts.note: Observed on the build machine, not assumed.
environment_facts.claude_code: 2.1.216 — chiron and primus both report Connected
environment_facts.build_caveat: the checkout is inside an iCloud-synced Desktop; codesign rejects .xctest bundles stamped with com.apple.FinderInfo, so Swift builds require --scratch-path outside the synced tree
environment_facts.gate_caveat: the gate battery regenerates Chiron/artifacts/*/latest.json and is not safe to run concurrently with another vault job
